timezone.label: ART (UTC−3)
timezone.tooltip: All dates and times are shown in Argentina time (ART, UTC−3). The backend delivers them in UTC and the dashboard converts them, including day cutoffs: daily extremes and every calendar cell run from local midnight to midnight, not UTC.

retainedBanner.other: — it will run on the next wake.
